tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// bsngo ba'i yon bshad longs spyod 'du ba'i 'khor lo dang*// bsngo ba'i rim pa legs bshad dga' ston bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)༄༅// de ring gi skabs su sbyin pa'i bdag pos// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi phung po lta bus nye bar mchod pa dang*// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba// dge 'dun gyi tshogs spyan drangs te// chos dang mthun pa'i bsnyen bkur ba kha na ma tho ba med pas mnyes par bgyid pa 'di nyid// bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshad pa dang bsgrub pas 'dzin pa rnams rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i sgo nas phyogs dus thams cad du yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ston pa'i 'di yan tshal// 'di nas/ zhal skyin 'gran zla med par gyur pa// gzhal ba la 'das pa'i thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid// bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*// bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu thams cad kyi sku'i ri dbang brtan zhing*/ mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyas pa dang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa kun gyi phan bde thams cad dar ba dang khyad 'di'i bar ljang ma/ par/ yongs 'di nas/ 'dzin dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang mi gnyis pa/ 'di zhes bya ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i ched dam/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi gtsos pa'i sems can thams cad gnas// skabs su mi mthun pa'i 'tshe ba mtha' dag 'joms shing tshe dang dpal gyi 'byor pa la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bde blag tu 'grub cing rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir ram/ dmigs yul che ge mo'i srid pa bar mdo la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las grol te// nye bar zhib dam pa'i pha rol son pa'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du (2na3)bsgrub par gda' bas// dge ba'i rtsa ba yangs shing rgya che ba 'di nyid// bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs pa gal che bas/

'di nyid kyi khyad par rgyu 'di la brten nas 'bras bu 'di lta bu zhig thob par gyur cig pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ rgyu de'i 'dod bya 'bras bu de bsgyur bar byed pas na bsngo ba// rgyu mngon du byas sam// ma byas kyang rung ste// spyir thob 'bras bu don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa// sems mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa smon lam ste bsngo brgya chung*/ smon lam g+r+ya che ba yin no// de la byang chub tu bsngo ba'i gdams pa ni/ paṇa chen bud+dha shrā+ais/ dam pa gsum gyi bsod nams bsags// rgya che thabs kyis yang dag spel// shes rab zab mos rnam dag bya// zung 'jug bsngo bas rgyas btab bo// zhes gsungs pas// dam pa gsum ni/ yul dam pa sbyin pa'i zhing*/ dngos po dam pa spyan pa'i rdzas/ bsam pa dam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pas kun nas blangs te/ dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las/ yon tan zhing dang phan 'dogs zhing*/ sdug bsngal ba la dge cher 'gyur/ zhes pas yon tan gyi zhing dkon mchog gsum// phan 'dogs kyi zhing*/ pham dang*/ dge ba'i bshes grogs dam pa/ sdug bsngal gyi zhing nad pa dang mgon med cing*// chad pas nyen pa la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ mngon pa kun las btus pa las/ sbyin pa bya ba'i dngos po gzhan las phrogs pa ma yin pa dang*/ sbyin par bya ba'i dngos po gnod pas bsgrubs pa ma yin pa dang*/ sbyin par bya ba'i dngos po ma rung zhing dri ma med pa dang*/ sbyin par bya ba'i dngos po rung ba dang*// sbyin par bya ba'i dngos po chos kyis bsgrubs pa zhes gsungs// gsum pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ rtog pa thams cad bral byas te/ (2ba4)skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te// de ltar de ni sems bskyed do// zhes gsungs// zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par gyi// mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las// zhes dang*/ mthong ba'i chos la myong 'gyur gyi las stobs dang ldan pa/

zhing bsam gyi bskyed pa yin no// rgya che thabs kyis yang dag spel/ bya ba ni dngos po mi gtso/ bsam pa gtso bas/ bsam pa rgya che ba bzhin/ bsod nams rgya che'o// des na yul rgya che ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems nyan rang thams cad/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ bsog mkhan rgya che ba rang res gtsos pa'i sems can thams cad kyi byed par bsam// bsog tshul rgya che ba thams cad kyi yan lag bdun pa byas na// sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur te/ bslab btus las/ de ltar sems can khams bzhin du/ bsod nams mtha' yas rab tu 'byung*/ zhes gsungs/ khyad par gzhan don du byang chub thob 'dod kyi kun nas blangs nas bsod nams lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur te/ de nyid las/ byang chub sems ni mdor bsdu na/ bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no// zhes dang*// dpal sbyin gyi zhus pa'i mdor// sems can kun gyi bsod nams kyis// phung po ji snyed yongs gzung ba// de snyed byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'byung*// zhes gsungs/ de ltar 'phel ba'i dge rtsa sems can thams cad la bltos med du sbyin pas// des sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams gnyis 'gyur 'phel bar 'gyur// des sangs rgyas sras bcas la mchod pa phul ba lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur ro// shes rab zab mos rnam dag bya/ zhes pa 'khor gsum du dmigs na// mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i dge rtsa (3na5)yin pas/ gnas skabs kyi bde skyid las 'khor ba las mi 'da' ste/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba// dkar po chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs// zhes pas/ dngos 'dzin grub pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ med 'dzin dgag pa'i mtshan ma thams cad ma dmigs par/ rtog pa'i shes rab kyi yongs su 'dzin par bsngos na dge rtsa dag par 'gyur te/

sdud pa las/ ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ 'dod na bsags dge yang*/ byang chub tu bsngo bas rgyas ma btab na 'dzad de/ log lta chen po'i chen po bskyed pa na/ dge rtsa chung ngu'i chung ngu tshun chad gcod par gsungs la/ de yang mdzod las/ med par lta bas rtsa ba gcod/ ces so// yul dam pa la khong khro skyes na bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i dge ba'ang 'joms te/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod pa sogs/ legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang*// khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed// ces gsungs/ bsags dge khyad par can yang*/ log par bsdos na chud gson zhing sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur// rlom sems kyis bsgrags pa na mthol nas 'dzad par gsungs// de dag ma byung na'ang*/ byang chub tu ma bsngos na rang rang gi 'bras bu phyung nas zad par 'gyur mi 'dzad/ ces dang*/ mdo las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yang byang chub kyi sems yongs su bzung zhing*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos na rnam par 'phel kho/ zhes gsungs/ de la bsngo rgyu zag bcas zag med kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad de/ sdud par/ slob dang (3ba6)slob dge ba zag bcas zag med par/ bsdus nas byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang zhing*/ 'gro ba'i don du byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo// bsngo ba 'grub pa'i rkyen tshul khrims dang ldan pas smon lam btab pa dang*/ 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ rgyu 'di ltas 'bras bu 'di lta bu thob par gyur cig /ces 'dun pa drag po'i de drag gzhan dbang gi 'bras bu che chung du 'byung ngo*// bsngos ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar ro// ched du bya ba rang gcig po dang 'ga' zhig gi don du ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo/ bsngo ba'i blo'i rnams/ kun rdzob tu dge rtsa 'di la brten nas gzhan don du byang chub thob par gyur cig pa'i 'dun pa dang*/

don dam par 'khor gsum gyi stong pa'i shes rab dang zung du 'jug pa'i 'dun pa drag po'i sgo nas bdag gi tshed du 'di'i mthun gyur gnang ba zhu lags/ zhes pa 'di/ 'gro mgon bla ma rgya mtshos bskul ba las/ pad+ma dkar pos go bde bar sbyar ba'o// tshal ma shin tu bsdus pa ste// de stengs ljang ma bsnan pas 'bring*// thams cad brjod pa rgyas bde// sna sbyar skabs don tog tu 'di// bcud la rgyas pa'i rgyas par bshad// dgongs rdzogs bkra shis gshin po yis// bsngo ba rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnams// rje yi legs bshad las shes byas// skabs su bab pa'i ngag brjod pa// de la mkhas rnams legs shes bya// de las kyang ni rgyas spro na// rigs pa'i lung mang po ston pa zab/// /yongs su bsngo ba chen por gtogs pa 'phral du mkho ba'i rim pa 'ga' bsnyad par bya ba las/ dang po bla ma bstan rim mam rgyun gyi bsngo ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bsod nams kyi gzhi lta bu bgyis pa dang*/ 'das pa dang da ltar ci yang bsags pa dang*/ (4na7)ma 'ongs pa bgyis par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i phung po thams cad gzhan gyis zil gyis mi non par bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing yangs la rgyas pas nam mkha'i khams khyab par gyur cig /de ltar dge legs kyi mthus rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs rje btsun bla ma 'di la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la bya ba mdzad pa thams cad sku tshe dpag med dang mnyam zhing sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gyur cig /bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phyir phas kyi rgol ba'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyi ched du bdag cag tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams dam pa'i chos thams cad 'dzin pa dang bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa dam pa la gcig tu brtson pas tshe 'di kar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang chen po thob par gyur cig

/bla ma sku khams bzang ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid sogs brjod do/// /'bul bsngo ni/ dgongs gsol 'dre/ bdag cag rnams kyis 'di ltar bsgrubs pa dang dum gsum pa'i dge ba'i phung po thams cad kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rnam pa thams cad par gyur nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag chen po 'di zhes pa'i spyan sngar 'bul bar bgyi'o// de ltar phul ba'i stobs kyis mnyes rab kyi mchog tu gyur nas sangs rgyas rnam par rol pa rgya mtshos bdag sogs sems can re re'i mdun du ngo mtshar ba'i snang bston pas rjes su 'dzin pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bdag nyid chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa (4ba8)thams cad bskor ba'i gsung gi dbyangs yan lag drug cu pa thos pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes kyi sgo pha mtha' yas pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi gzhal med khang chen po'i dga' ba nyams su myong ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma dam pa 'di'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la bsnyan bkur bas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad rdzogs nas rje btsun dam pa de nyid 'grub par gyur cig /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa sogs brjod do/// /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bar ma'i bsngo ba/ dgongs gsol 'di zhes bya ba'i thugs rgyud la dgongs/ 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge legs kyi mthu chen bos bshes gnyen chen po 'di rtag tu 'khrungs te thos bsam bsgom pa mthar phyin pas sto pa gnyis pa lta bur gyur cig /de'i byang chub kyi sems dang de'i spyad pa spyod pa'i gegs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /sa nas sar 'phar ba'i rgyu'i tshogs thams cad rang gi rang gi snyed de ngal ba dang skyo dub med par mthar phyin par gyur cig

/myur ba nyid du bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes nas sems can thams cad kyi don mtha' yas pa mdzad par gyur cig /gang gi slob ma'i tshogs 'di dag kyang de nyid dge ba'i bshes su 'dzin pas rtag tu dam pa'i chos spyod pa kho nar gyur cig /byang chub sems ni rin po ches sogs brjod/// /gshin bsngo ni/ drag pa la/ sku gshegs pa 'di'i thugs la zhes dgongs gsol byas// 'di ltar shul du mchis pa bsgrubs pa dang*// sku gshegs pa de nyid kyi// gzhan 'dra// tshe 'das de nyid dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyis/ sku gshegs sam tshe 'das de nyid srid pa bar mdo'i 'jigs pa dang ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i las kyi nus pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /skye ba thams cad du mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan par gyur te skyid pa'i dpal thams cad la longs spyod par gyur cig /de dag tu yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su gzung ste (5na9) sdig pa'i skabs mi 'byed par dge ba'i las dang dam pa'i chos kho na la 'jug par gyur cig /zhugs nas kyang dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa mthar phyin gyi bar du chos dang mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa de thob par gyur cig /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ram/ ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong ba sogs brjod/ tshogs bsngo/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di la dgongs gsol byas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'dis 'di ltar du bsod nams kyi gzhi bgyis ba de nyid kyi dus gsum pa'i dge ba'i stobs kyis sbyin pa po 'di tshe 'dir nad dang gnod pa dang bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /mthun pa'i rkyen tshe ring ba dang*/ gzugs bzang ba dang dpal dang 'byor pa rnam thos kyi bu lta bur phyug par gyur cig /rtag tu dge ba la spro bas dam pa'i chos la 'jug pa dang sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig

/'jig rten gyi khams su lo chu legs shing char chu dus su 'bab pa dang*/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal thams cad 'byung bar gyur cig /lhag par bdag cag gnas pa'i phyogs 'dir gdug pa can gyi bsam sbyor zhi zhing phan pa sgrub pa dang phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas thams cad 'byung bar gyur cig /gang gis sbyin pa gang la sbyin// sogs brjod/ sngags grwar dgos zhes bskul nas/ pad+ma dkar pos bzung bder sbyar ba'o/// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs pu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
